deckTitle: Jung and Shinn: A Guide to Cosmic Cringe
verdict: This deck is a scholarly-satirical knockout — Jung's archetypes and Florence Scovel Shinn's affirmation metaphysics collide in ways that shouldn't work and absolutely do. THE SHADOW, ENANTIODROMIA, CRYPTOMNESIA, and THE SCHIZOPHRENIC SUN are among the best single cards in the entire Kayfabizarro corpus. The weak link is the Shinn-only cards (THE BLANKETS, THE DITCHES) where the biblical/affirmation context is inaccessible without a program note. No standalone cover is the one structural miss — this deck deserves a face. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: Jung's archetypes meet Shinn's affirmation magic in 60 cards that weaponize the unconscious. For psychology nerds, improv players, and anyone who's ever baptized a failure as success.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: JUNG AND SHINN – A Guide to Cosmic Cringe (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Half this deck wants you to climb down into the basement and shake hands with the monster. The other half wants you to stand in that same basement and affirm, out loud, that there was never any monster at all.

Picture the modern seeker's day. Morning: shadow journaling, naming the ugly thing, doing the deep Jungian descent. Evening: an abundance affirmation whispered to a vision board, the failure rebranded as a lesson, the panic baptized as a blessing in disguise. Two operating systems running on the same nervous system, and they are never once introduced to each other. One drags everything into the light to be examined. The other speaks a tidy word over it so nobody has to look. The cringe is not a bug in either tradition. It is what happens when you run both at full volume and pretend they agree.

So we put them in the ring together. This is Social Story Wrestling for the unconscious and the affirmation industry at the same time: 60 cut-and-play cards where the Shadow and the Spoken Word fight for control of the same self, you perform the move out loud, and the table rules whether the descent held or the cope tapped out.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Cosmic Cringe Core Deck: 60 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring THE SHADOW (the part of you that runs the show precisely because you refuse to look at it), ENANTIODROMIA (push any virtue hard enough and watch it flip into its own opposite), and THE $50,000 DOLLAR PANIC (Florence Scovel Shinn's money terror, the moment the affirmation cracks and the fear leaks through).
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and RAF dice boxes printed on every one of the 60 cards to settle who carried the round.
- The Two-Tradition Engine: one half built from Jungian analytical psychology (Anima, Persona, Mandala, the Transcendent Function, Cryptomnesia), the other from Shinn's affirmation metaphysics (the Spoken Word, the Golden Link, the Magic Purse), wired to collide so the table watches depth-work and wishful thinking try to pin each other.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
This deck rides the Kayfabizarro main line. Grab it and you are not buying a frozen PDF, you are on the Protopian Pipeline: every future expansion and crossover in this cycle reaches you as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these for the people stuck between the therapist telling them to feel it all and the guru telling them to manifest it away, who suspect both are half right and neither will admit it. Hold the two in one hand and you stop being run by either. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Print it. Cut it. Wrestle your own basement on whatever table you have. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and sharpening the mechanics.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"The shadow you refuse to name is the one quietly picking your affirmations."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
